value.rationale: Third connected occupancy moments are the first genuinely higher-order responses beyond established pairwise Rayleigh repulsion. All distinct triples have an exact topology-only strict sign, independent of arbitrary edge activities and path lengths, with a sharp 2-arm/3-arm positive-cumulant threshold and exact census. This complete natural all-size classification is not a small numerical coefficient increment or a restatement of pairwise negativity.
